project.title: Targeted tiled amplicon based protocol for sequencing the Hemagglutinin (HA) gene segment of seasonal Influenza A and Influenza B virus from wastewater
project.description: We performed tiled amplicon sequencing targeting the Hemagglutinin (HA) gene segment for Influenza A H1, Influenza A H3, and Influenza B Victoria using a custom primer scheme on samples collected from wastewater utilities within Colorado's sentinel surveillance system with collection dates between August 2024 and January 2025.
